answer: Skeptical of every score, so the network seeds decoy jobs whose correct answer is already known. An identity that signs off on a bad honeypot loses the seat and the bond. Auditors come from a rotating pool and never sit twice in a row. One decoy batch, nicknamed lotus, sat in the queue a full epoch and caught four seats. Farming costs more than it returns once each fake seat must survive unseen traps, and a timber frame of borrowed reputation does not help when a single miss resets the stake. The river only carries work that passed.
